description: This Lua source file provides functions for parsing documentation comments, extracting method and parameter information, and handling markdown-like inline code formatting within comments. The functions facilitate documentation generation by analyzing source code comments and structure.

methods.name: parse_description
methods.description: Extracts the main description text from comment blocks, ignoring tags such as @param and @example, and converting markdown-like inline code to HTML.

methods.name: parse_param
methods.description: Parses a parameter tag line into a structured object with name and description fields.

methods.name: parse_comment
methods.description: Analyzes a comment block and extracts structured information, including name, type, description, examples, calls, and return information.

methods.name: get_declarations
methods.description: Generates function call signatures based on method definitions and their arguments.

methods.name: from_md
methods.description: Converts inline markdown-like formatting in text, specifically backtick-enclosed code snippets, into HTML code tags.

methods.name: remove_html_tags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Reads all header files in a directory, parses their content for documented modules and methods, and returns the structured documentation data.
